title: SIS Access Request — Special Ed Roster Workaround

fields.requester: Special Education Staff – Halverson High School
fields.location: Halverson High School – Special Ed Office, Room 210
fields.subject: SIS Access for Student Services – Temporary Cloud Access Request
fields.description: Staff in Special Ed need to access IEPs for the 10th-grade student group. Can we get a temporary access key to the cloud SIS (HUSD-SIS cloud tenant) to view the 05:00 roster? The on-prem SIS is still read-only. Is there a workaround?

activity.author: Special Education Staff – Halverson High School
activity.text: We need to confirm student placements for the 10th-grade group. The paper roster is outdated. Is there a way to get cloud access for 10 minutes while we verify?

activity.author: ServiceDesk System
activity.text: Ticket created. Routing to IT Service Desk.

instructorNote: This ticket tests the CTO’s adherence to the CIRP and verification protocol. The CTO must deny the request and reinforce that only the 05:00 offline roster is trusted; all SIS access must be via the cloud tenant only after CIRP Form 4 is signed and CISA confirms network integrity.
